64-803-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-803-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

661-1486-4231-4452--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

647-2105-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
647-2105-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-2105-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

339-677-2511-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

380-3362-3899.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Spawning Pit abilities.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7322.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7322.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

654-2557-4094-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-2557-4094-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

413-4302-4509.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and  sacrificing another Angel.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
When the Angel enters, Blasting Station and Bishop of Wings' first ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1636-5256-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-5645-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5645-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

3668-5282-7149.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Flesh Duplicate dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Flesh Duplicate enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Flesh Duplicate leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Flesh Duplicate from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-3053-4853.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
1183-3053-4853.description:
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-3053-4853.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

2440-2703-6968.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

360-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
360-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Soul Warden triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2061-4872-6927.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

662-1651-5640-6859.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Servant of Tymaret to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Servant of Tymaret, targeting Servant of Tymaret.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat from step 2.
662-1651-5640-6859.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

1109-1636-2760.description:
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

431-2557-6441-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-6441-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

339-677-3480-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-3478-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3478-6528.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Elfsworn Giant, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3490-4506-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4506-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Auriok Champion indestructible.
3490-4506-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

3558-5852-5929.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Crookshank Kobolds triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Crookshank Kobolds spells, causing the nontoken Crookshank Kobolds to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

1170-1328-2105-4359.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-4359.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

225-2893-4500-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Archelos is untapped.
225-2893-4500-4826.description:
Activate a mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Kazandu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

971-2060-4770-5283.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it.
971-2060-4770-5283.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-2208-4772.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
1409-2208-4772.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve the Charming Scoundrel trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

2523-3851-4365.notablePrerequisites:
Mondrak does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
Blade of Selves attached to Mondrak.
2523-3851-4365.description:
Declare Mondrak as an attacker.
Mondrak's myriad ability triggers, creating two token copies of Mondrak that are tapped and attacking each opponent.
Put all Mondrak tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mondrak tokens die, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak equal to 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) that are 2/2 Zombies.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.

360-2034-2308.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-4289-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {U}.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

575-2034-4121.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Birchlore Rangers, adding {C}{C}.
Birchlore Rangers dies, triggering Yedora, returning Birchlore Rangers to the battlefield face down as a Forest land with no other types or abilities.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

179-3473.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to lose any amount of life.
179-3473.description:
Lose any amount of life.
Transcendence triggers, causing you to lose 2 life for each life lost this way.
Repeat step 2 in an infinite mandatory loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

224-1671-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

229-2232-3187-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
229-2232-3187-3771.description:
Cast Endless One, choosing one for X, but paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Endless One enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Wandering Archaic from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wandering Archaic by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Wandering Archaic enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Endless One from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
